questions.text: What paradox does the first reading text describe?
opts: Kazakhstan is large but has no attractions
Students travel abroad before exploring their own country
Trains are more expensive than flights
questions.correct: Students travel abroad before exploring their own country
questions.hint: "Many have travelled to countries far away but have never explored their own."

questions.text: What is the "shoulder season" for travel in Kazakhstan?
questions.hint: "Travel in shoulder seasons (May-June and September-October) — less crowded and cheaper."

questions.text: Why did Daniyar go to Georgia as his first trip abroad?
opts: No visa required and relatively affordable
questions.correct: No visa required and relatively affordable
questions.hint: "Popular precisely because they require no visa and are relatively affordable."

questions.text: The text recommends trying to see many cities in a short time.
questions.hint: "Going deeper into fewer places — spending four or five days in one city rather than one day in five."

questions.text: Daniyar saved 5,000 tenge a month for ___ months.
questions.hint: "I saved 5,000 tenge a month for eight months."

questions.text: The texts both agree on one key piece of advice. What is it?
opts: Start with domestic travel; go abroad later
questions.correct: Start with domestic travel; go abroad later
questions.hint: Reading 1: "Start with somewhere inside the country." Reading 2: "Book the ticket... and go."

questions.text: What room type did Kamila book at the hotel?
questions.hint: "I'd prefer a single room." — Kamila booked a standard single room.

questions.text: What is the hotel's cancellation policy?
opts: Free up to 24 hours before check-in
questions.correct: Free up to 24 hours before check-in
questions.hint: "Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in. After that, one night's charge applies."

questions.text: How much does Rustam's checked bag weigh?
questions.hint: "Just one bag to check in. It's 18 kilograms." — within the 23 kg allowance.

questions.text: What time does Rustam's flight to Almaty depart?
questions.hint: "Your flight to Almaty departs at 10:15."

questions.text: Rustam must ___ his laptop and place it in a tray at security.
questions.hint: "Remove your laptop and place it separately in the tray."

questions.text: Is this Rustam's first flight?
questions.hint: "I've never flown before — I want to see the view." — confirmed first flight.

questions.text: "I'll help you!" — "will" is used because:
questions.hint: "will" = spontaneous decision/offer made at the moment. ✅

questions.text: "I'm flying to Georgia on the 15th." — Present Continuous here means:
questions.hint: Present Continuous for future = confirmed arrangement with specific time. ✅

questions.text: "The train departs at 08:30." — Present Simple here is used for:
questions.hint: Present Simple for official schedules/timetables. "departs" = fixed schedule. ✅

questions.text: "Look — it ___ (rain). I can see dark clouds!"
questions.hint: Evidence-based prediction = GOING TO. "It IS GOING TO RAIN." ✅

questions.text: "She ___ a flight to Istanbul." Correct collocation:
questions.hint: "BOOK a flight." ✅ You book flights, hotel rooms, tickets.

questions.text: "We arrived ___ Tbilisi." Correct preposition:
questions.hint: "arrive IN" + city. "We arrived IN Tbilisi." ✅ NEVER "arrive to."

questions.text: "She went ___ a day trip to Charyn Canyon." Correct phrase:
questions.hint: "go ON a day trip." ✅ You go on: a trip, a tour, a holiday, an excursion.

questions.text: "Make the ___ of your time in Georgia." Complete the phrase.
questions.hint: "Make THE MOST OF" = use to the fullest extent. ✅ "make the most of your time."

questions.text: "Domestic tourism is growing." "Domestic" means:
questions.hint: "domestic" = relating to your own country; not foreign.

questions.text: "Accommodation in popular areas fills up quickly." "Accommodation" means:
questions.hint: "accommodation" = a place to stay — hotel, hostel, apartment, etc.

questions.text: "She travels light." This means:
questions.hint: "travel light" = pack as little luggage as possible. A backpack, not a suitcase.

questions.text: "Planning the itinerary." "Itinerary" means:
opts: A planned route of places to visit
questions.correct: A planned route of places to visit
questions.hint: "itinerary" = the schedule of a journey — which places, in which order.

questions.text: "The trip was rewarding." "Rewarding" means:
questions.hint: "rewarding" = giving a strong feeling of satisfaction and fulfilment.
